visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single poll question with answer buttons and no correct answer
visualCharacteristics.layout: centred question with a wrapping row of answer buttons

contentPattern.structure: optional "Thank you message" | text row; a "Questions" row; optional "Back label" | text row; then question | option | result rows (first row holds the question, following rows leave cell 1 empty; the third cell is the result shown for that option, a bare quiz "correct" flag is ignored)
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Mini poll: question "What is your main motivation behind managing obesity?" with options Gaining health / Weight loss / Appearance

usage: Motivation poll on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for one-question opinion polls. Use quiz for scored multi-question quizzes. Fires a bubbling "poll:answered" event for analytics.
